exact_query_text: A visible person falls to the ground and remains down or begins to get up.
A vehicle door opens into the ego vehicle's travel corridor and creates a possible collision constraint.
A road user overtakes the ego vehicle and then cuts into its path.
The ego vehicle changes speed or path in response to a visible red traffic signal.
A previously stationary object appears in the ego vehicle's immediate path and requires avoidance.
The lead vehicle ahead slows or stops and the ego vehicle follows with marked deceleration.
